normalization: NFC UTF-8; long s becomes s; unambiguous abbreviation signs expand only as individually documented; horizontal chant syllable spacing and physical line-end division hyphens join into words. Source u/v, i/j, ligatures, accents, case including display initials, punctuation, printed referrals, rubric wording and response markers remain. A printed pilcrow remains ¶ and response cue becomes ℟. Each stored LF is one consecutive source block distinguished by source wording, voice or ink; it is not newly inferred prayer paragraphing. Staff notation and pitches remain in the facsimile, not the Latin payload. No explanatory wrapper or source-completing wording is inserted.

source_boundary_audit.scope: Complete functional Pater constituent in offered source order: FIDES page-file 0275 (printed p.213), right column from Orémus after the earlier Canon/Iungit manus, through the introduction and adjacent Extendit manus; all page-file 0276 (printed p.214) body text, including the first complete Pater and response/Amen, the governing alternative-cantus rubric for three-lesson feasts, ferial days and Masses for the dead, the separately printed Per omnia/Amen and second introduction/Pater; and page-file 0277 (printed p.215), left column through Sacerdos submissâ voce dicit / Amén. It stops before the right-column Deinde accipit Patenam and Libera nos. Both complete printed chant forms and all governing rubrics are included. Final Amén. preserves the independently preferred probable printed acute over e in a worn/folded area; the hooked mark meets a crease, so that diacritic retains an explicit source-condition reservation. This complete declared functional constituent has partial whole-book and partial post-Canon text coverage. The wider continuation through page-file 0285 remains blocked by concealed source letters and punctuation; no alternate-setting words fill those gaps.

source_boundary_audit.baseline_convention: Source-block addresses count every visible text baseline, including marginal action text, down each column; repeated same-baseline ink fragments share an address. The independent physical-group census separately excludes marginal action rows from its main-text count. Both conventions are explicitly identified; they locate the same original source blocks.

final_amen_source_condition.locus: Black final response after the terminal red Sacerdos submissa voce di- / cit, rubric; this review arbitrates only the response mark and stop.
final_amen_source_condition.method: Directly inspected the supplied terminal-response crop and the previously decoded complete native PNG, followed by an unretouched native-resolution crop of that same PNG. No new decoding, acquisition, OCR or broad recollation. Familiar liturgical spelling was not used to decide the mark.
final_amen_source_condition.reading_confidence: The acute is supported, with residual material uncertainty from the worn/folded source. The terminal full stop is clear.
positive_evidence: The dark stroke is discrete and centered over the e, within the vertical space where the source places accents.
Its lower end lies slightly to the left of its upper end, compatible with an acute even though the surviving shape is upright and hooked.
Its darkness is comparable to the black response letters. The nearby broad crease tracks are paler.
The full stop after n is a separate clear black point.
final_amen_source_condition.material_uncertainty: The upper end of the mark meets a physical crease, and the stroke is less regular than a pristine sloping acute. These bytes do not prove that wear contributed nothing to its surviving shape. A source-condition note should preserve this reservation; the preferred reading remains Amén.
final_amen_source_condition.scope_limit: This addendum arbitrates the terminal response mark and stop only. It does not alter frozen extent outputs, settle the separately reviewed dícere punctuation, or provide candidate-specific whole-binding literal acceptance.

native_detail_crop.recipe: ImageMagick input-native-PNG -crop 1500x620+250+4230 +repage output-PNG; no resize, sharpen, color or content alteration.

supplied_comparison_crop.status: Secondary crop directly inspected and compared with the native source; its generation recipe is not certified by this addendum.

reviewed_corrections: The first invitation ends dícere. with acute on i only; no final e acute is asserted.
The first Pater prints dimítte, while the second prints dimitte without acute; the actual difference is preserved.
The final rubric reads submissâ; final Amén. preserves the preferred printed-acute reading with its explicit crease/wear source-condition note.
